{{Quote|They're all gone. Every last one of them. Sev. Rutigar. Deksi. Everyone.|Naz Felyood's writings on a seven-thousand-year-old parchment|<ref name="Date" />}}
'''Sev''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who served aboard the pirate [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Jynni's Virtue]]'', [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Naz Felyood]]. While trying to [[Attack on the Jynni's Virtue (Korriban)|escape]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the freighter crashed on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. After the crash, Sev was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Korriban zombie]]s and was reanimated as a [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] that returned to [[Attack on the Jynni's Virtue (Korriban surface)|attack]] the ''Jynni's Virtue''{{'s}} crew. However, during the attack, Sev's zombie was shot by the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]], [[Babbnod Luroon]].

==History==
{{Quote|This sounds insane, but [DAMAGE] dead, but they don't seem to know it yet. The reason I know they're dead? Because I saw Sev and Derec out there.|Part of a damaged recording by Babbnod Luroon|<ref name="Date" />}}
[[File:Moraband-FDCR.png|thumb|right|300px|Sev crash landed on Korriban (pictured)]]
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Sev was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who worked for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Naz Felyood]] on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Jynni's Virtue]]''. Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Jynni's Virtue'' was [[Attack on the Jynni's Virtue (Korriban)|attacked]] over the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|tombworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol [[Starship/Legends|ships]] equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shields]]. The ''Jynni's Virtue'' crashed on the surface of Korriban near the planet's equator, causing Sev&mdash;along with everyone else aboard&mdash;to be stranded in the [[Valley of Golg]] near a [[Dathka Graush's tomb|Sith tomb]]. While exploring the planet, Naz Felyood discovered the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] and was possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]], an act which caused his undead [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Korriban zombie]]s to awaken. Some time after the [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] were unleashed, Sev was bitten by one, and he was infected with a plague that was transmitted through the zombie's bite. Sev died from the zombie attack, but the plague later reanimated his body.<ref name="KPLS4" />

Three days after Felyood was possessed by Graush, the zombies of Sev and several other beings attacked the ''Jynni's Virtue''. Even though he was missing part of his face and one of his [[Limb/Legends|arms]], the reanimated zombie of Sev, along with many others, [[Attack on the Jynni's Virtue (Korriban surface)|attacked]] the ''Jynni's Virtue''. During the skirmish, the zombies of Sev and [[Derec]], another pirate-turned-zombie, assaulted [[Babbnod Luroon]], Felyood's [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]]. However, when the zombie that was once Sev attacked her with a rusty [[Sword/Legends|sword]], Luroon killed him and Derec with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="KPLS4" /> Naz Felyood later recorded Sev's death on a piece of seven-thousand-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old parchment when he wrote about the incident while stranded on Korriban.<ref name="KPLS5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031030korriban5|series=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|text=Part 5: Sole Survivor}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sev's arm was gone, and half his face looked chewed away, but on he came, trying to take my head off with a rusty sword.|Part of a recording by Babbnod Luroon describing Sev as a zombie|<ref name="Date" />}}
Sev's [[Species/Legends|species]] had a face and at least two arms.<ref name="KPLS4" /> By 1 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> he had turned to piracy and served under captain Naz Felyood. When he was reanimated as a zombie, he was missing one of his arms, and part of his face was gone.<ref name="KPLS4" />

==Equipment==
As a zombie, Sev was armed with a rusty sword.<ref name="KPLS4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sev was mentioned in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplement "[[Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls]]," which was written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] as part of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Planet Hoppers]] series on [[Wizards.com]]. The part of the supplement first mentioning Sev was published on [[October 23]], [[2003]].<ref name="KPLS4" />
